definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT 
    b."BATCH_ID",
    CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
    'HIST_RAW' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
    o."SOURCE_FILE",
    "d"."BUKRS","d"."BUTXT","d"."ORT01","d"."LAND1","d"."WAERS","d"."SPRAS","d"."KTOPL","d"."WAABW","d"."PERIV","d"."KOKFI","d"."RCOMP","d"."ADRNR","d"."STCEG","d"."FIKRS","d"."XFMCO","d"."XFMCB","d"."XFMCA","d"."TXJCD","d"."FMHRDATE","d"."BUVAR","d"."FDBUK","d"."XFDIS","d"."XVALV","d"."XSKFN","d"."KKBER","d"."XMWSN","d"."MREGL","d"."XGSBE","d"."XGJRV","d"."XKDFT","d"."XPROD","d"."XEINK","d"."XJVAA","d"."XVVWA","d"."XSLTA","d"."XFDMM","d"."XFDSD","d"."XEXTB","d"."EBUKR","d"."KTOP2","d"."UMKRS","d"."BUKRS_GLOB","d"."FSTVA","d"."OPVAR","d"."XCOVR","d"."TXKRS","d"."WFVAR","d"."XBBBF","d"."XBBBE","d"."XBBBA","d"."XBBKO","d"."XSTDT","d"."MWSKV","d"."MWSKA","d"."IMPDA","d"."XNEGP","d"."XKKBI","d"."WT_NEWWT","d"."PP_PDATE","d"."INFMT","d"."FSTVARE","d"."KOPIM","d"."DKWEG","d"."OFFSACCT","d"."BAPOVAR","d"."XCOS","d"."XCESSION","d"."XSPLT","d"."SURCCM","d"."DTPROV","d"."DTAMTC","d"."DTTAXC","d"."DTTDSP","d"."DTAXR","d"."XVATDATE","d"."PST_PER_VAR","d"."XBBSC","d"."FM_DERIVE_ACC"
FROM "1_INBOUND_HIST_RAW.1LT_T001_HIST_RAW" d
	CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_HIST_RAW_01" b
	JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o 
	    ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID" 
	        AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'HIST_RAW' 
	        AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'T001'
